topics.title: Why Luděk quit his job in social work?
topics.description: He started working in the social sector because he felt he should help people. However, after a few years, he realized that as a social worker, he was also a social case. The combination of low pay and his growing interest in computers led him to quit his job in social work.

topics.title: Where Luděk learned IT skills?
topics.description: Luděk had his first experiences with computers as a child when he attended a computer club at the youth center. There, he wrote his first code using Basic. His first computer was a ZX Spectrum. As a child, he was interested in gaming, so he spent a lot of time with his friends exploring the world of computers. Luděk is a big fan of open source. As an adult, he learned coding by customizing existing open-source solutions. He started with HTML and CSS customization of Drupal themes. Later, he realized he was achieving good SEO results and decided to focus on that field. He worked as an online marketing consultant for several years. As an SEO consultant, he worked as a freelancer, which brought him into contact with the world of programming. He developed some small websites and later became an online marketing specialist and e-shop webmaster. At this point, learning scripting became necessary. So, he bought books and learned MySQL and PHP. Later, he joined CN Group as a Drupal developer. This was a major boost for his knowledge and coding skills, as he received feedback from more experienced programmers and learned how to work in teams on large projects. He attended internal company courses (Symfony, GenAI, AWS) and used Udemy as a resource for lifelong learning. He has an AWS Developer Associate certification. Now, Luděk is focusing on GenAI, cloud computing, and cybersecurity topics.

The main technology stack for the project included Drupal, Docker, PHP, AWS, and GitLab. He also worked on a smaller TypeScript-based microservice.

topics.title: What services do you offer in Drupal development?

topics.title: How can Luděk help my business with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) development?
topics.description: LLM chatbots are useful for sharing information, but large language models usually don't have detailed knowledge about your business. With RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), the language model is enhanced with information that isn't public or is too specific. RAG allows you to retrieve information from different sources, aggregate it, and use vector search to find not only lexical matches but also semantic matches. RAG is more effective than traditional search.
